positive.point: Using a live case study with real results to lead sales efforts instead of cold calling.
Building connections by being a good listener and remembering details.
The idea of making application forms for event sponsorship requests to filter serious inquiries.
The advice to treat sales like gardening, nurturing a few warm leads instead of cold-calling many strangers.
The suggestion to use a calm boundary when responding to discount requests, emphasizing the value of the service.

negative.point: Struggling with cold calling due to anxiety and imposter syndrome.
Emails being sent to spam when reaching out to potential clients.
Difficulty in getting responses from cold outreach and low conversion rates.
Losing jobs due to inability to respond to leads quickly enough.
Challenges in finding clients and feeling discouraged despite efforts in outreach and networking.
